# Mohammed Alhabbarah (محمد الحبارة)

> Head of Learning & Capability Development at CAMCO – Capital Metro Company (operator of Riyadh Metro Lines 1 and 2), Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Competency development expert and technical readiness leader: technical training, competency management systems (CMS), knowledge transfer, talent pipelines and workforce readiness in safety-critical industries (railways, oil & gas, construction). Arabic and English.

Arabic name: محمد الحبارة. Motto: “From the field… to impact” (من الميدان… إلى الأثر).
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/mohammed-alhabbarah/
Website: https://nouraldeentofi.com/sites/mohammed-alhabbarah/ (Arabic) · https://nouraldeentofi.com/sites/mohammed-alhabbarah/en/ (English)

## Key facts

- Current role: Head of Learning & Capability Development, CAMCO (May 2026 – present), Riyadh Metro Project.
- Previous at CAMCO: Technical Capability Readiness Manager (May 2024 – May 2026); Competence Management System Expert (May 2023 – May 2024).
- Earlier: Training and Recruitment Specialist, Education For Employment Saudi (2021–2023); L&D Supervisor and L&D Specialist, Nasser S. Al-Hajri Corporation (2018–2021); Training Lead, OGM Technical Institute, Bahrain (2020–2021); Administrative Clerk, Abdullah Ali Al Amer & Brothers Trading Co (2016–2018).
- Delivered technical training to 3,220+ employees through 8,000+ learning interventions for Riyadh Metro operational readiness.
- Established CAMCO's Training Management System and Competency Management System, formally validated by the Transport General Authority (TGA).
- Honoured among the Riyadh Metro Heroes (Royal Commission for Riyadh City and Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development).
- Bronze award, Best Learning & Development Program, Saudi CX Awards 2025 (representing CAMCO).
- Part of the NSH team that won Saudi Aramco's IKTVA Award (2018) for Best in Training and Development of Saudi Manpower.
- Co-led the establishment of OGM Technical Institute in Bahrain; led competency reassessment and recertification for 600+ employees in safety-critical operations.
- Reduced training cycle time by 25% and raised post-training feedback by 40% (LMS automation, AI-enabled learning, enhanced TNA).
- Certifications: CPTD (ATD, 2024), PMP (PMI, 2021), SPTD (Human Capital Institute, 2023), TVTC Certified Trainer (2021), CLDM (Middle Earth HR, 2021), Competency Assessor & Verifier Training (2023), Internal Auditor Training (TÜV SÜD, 2024).
- Education: MBA in progress at Ahlia University, Bahrain (from 2026); CIPD Level 5 Associate Diploma in People Management (2021–2022); BA English Language & Literature, King Faisal University (2013–2017).
- Languages: Arabic (native), English (full professional).

## Experience (full)

### CAMCO – Capital Metro Company — Full-time · 3 yrs 6 mos · Riyadh
**Head of Learning & Capability Development** · May 2026 – Present · On-site
I lead Learning & Capability Development at CAMCO — training, competency management, knowledge transfer, talent development, Saudization and workforce readiness across the Riyadh Metro Project — with full ownership of resources and budget.
- Senior interface with clients, subcontractors and regulators, including the Transport General Authority (TGA) and the Royal Commission for Riyadh City.
- Designing a talent pipeline programme aligned with succession-planning policy, with structured selection and leadership-readiness assessment.
- Building a career progression framework with clear pathways across all roles, strengthening retention.
- Setting the policies, procedures, contracting mechanisms and selection methodology for a Graduate Development Programme and leadership programmes with the Human Resources Development Fund (Hadaf).
- Working with the IBM Maximo and TMS/LMS teams, and evaluating AI-powered LXPs (Sana AI, 360Learning) and skills-intelligence platforms (Eightfold AI).
- Governance frameworks and executive reporting that strengthen KPI achievement and regulatory confidence.

**Technical Capability Readiness Manager** · May 2024 – May 2026 · 2 yrs 1 mo
I directed the technical training strategy for CAMCO’s operational workforce and subcontractors, tying every initiative to project timelines, quality and regulatory readiness.
- Led three departments — Technical Training, Competency Management and Knowledge Transfer — and built their policies, procedures and strategies.
- TNAs and risk-based TNAs (RBTNA), with mitigation plans that protect timelines and quality.
- Oversaw the Training Management System and Competency Management System for CAMCO and all subcontractor staff.
- Central liaison between CAMCO, subcontractors and external stakeholders: RCRC, TGA, PMS and BACS.
- Built and managed the annual Technical Training and Knowledge Transfer budget.
- Tracked training, OJT and competency assessments, reporting technical readiness to senior management.

**Competence Management System Expert** · May 2023 – May 2024 · 1 yr 1 mo
I owned CAMCO’s Competency Management System end-to-end — design, assessment, verification and continuous improvement — keeping every safety-critical role compliant with ORR and ROGS guidelines.
- Solution Owner for CMS preparation, programming, implementation and standardisation, with its framework, procedure and policies.
- Competency mapping, technical training matrices and assessor guidelines for each directorate.
- Worked with subcontractor heads and SMEs to secure 100% assessment-evidence completion.
- Standardisation meetings with the Internal Verifier, and policy updates as safety-critical activities changed.
- Skills-gap analysis, periodic CMS effectiveness reports to the client, and audit-ready certification records.

### Education For Employment in Saudi (EFE) — Full-time · Riyadh
**Training and Recruitment Specialist** · Aug 2021 – Jul 2023 · 2 yrs
I designed the national training calendar and launched a customised LMS: scheduling efficiency up 40%, and 85% adoption in its first quarter.
- Training needs assessments with programme teams, aligning curricula with labour-market demand and partner expectations.
- A trainer monitoring system that reduced delivery issues.
- Cut training-report turnaround by 50% with automated tracking and digital evaluation tools.
- Recruited and onboarded 50+ certified technical and soft-skills trainers.
- A RACI matrix, a full training library and a Trello-based task system.
- Represented EFE at national job fairs and university career days.

### Nasser S. Al-Hajri Corporation (NSH) — Full-time · 3 yrs 5 mos · Dammam
**Learning and Development Supervisor** · May 2021 – Aug 2021 · 4 mos
I supervised 200+ technical training sessions and practical assessments, and lifted trainer performance by 30% through observation, feedback and coaching.
- 100% compliance with internal and Aramco-mandated safety standards in training environments.
- Coordinated with Aramco’s Talent Development and Local Content divisions on Saudization goals.
- Weekly training, OJT and assessment reports, and supervision of final assessments before certification.

**Learning and Development Specialist** · Apr 2018 – May 2021 · 3 yrs 2 mos
I inducted 1,200+ new trainees in welding, electrical, scaffolding, pipefitting and safety, and built KPIs that took course completion to 90%.
- English and soft-skills content for several sites, delivered to technical trainees.
- Lead translator and cultural mediator in bilingual sessions.
- Led a team of 4 trainers preparing the English courses (Jun – Sep 2018).
- Part of the NSH team that won Aramco’s 2018 IKTVA Award for the best training and development of Saudi manpower.

### OGM Technical Institute — Part-time · Muharraq, Bahrain
**Training Lead** · Feb 2020 – Aug 2021 · 1 yr 7 mos

### Abdullah Ali Al Amer & Brothers Trading Co — Full-time · Al-Ahsa

## Method (from his LinkedIn posts)

### Start from the job, not a ready-made list
A list like “communication, teamwork, problem-solving” is correct, but it doesn’t say what someone must do in the field to succeed. So I start from the job itself.
Source: https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7512401731872505857/

### Four levels… based on what?
Beginner, intermediate, advanced, expert. What separates two technicians isn’t years or the number of faults handled — it’s what we see in their work in the field.
Source: https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7514940445265649664/

### Three people build the framework
An excellent competency framework can end up unused if it’s built as an HR project alone. HR knows the method; the operations manager knows the work in the field.
Source: https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7513834717582872576/

### Is it really a training problem?
One of the most common requests we get: “the team needs training”. Before looking for a programme, we need to know where the problem is.
Source: https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7510949775505063936/

### 70:20:10 — a development plan, not a training plan
I don’t dwell on the ratios; what matters is how we think about developing people. Too often we reverse it: find the gap, then go straight to a course.
Source: https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7505874323396763648/

### Career progression is wider than promotion
Many people tie progress to one question: was I promoted or not? Promotion is part of career progression — not all of it.
Source: https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7507678576004161536/

## Field notes (LinkedIn posts, originally in Arabic)

- 2026-10-11 — مبتدئ، متوسط، متقدم، خبير… بس على أي أساس؟ — Competency level comes from real performance in the field, not years or titles: autonomy, complexity, impact and consistency. (https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7514940445265649664/)
- 2026-10-08 — ممكن تبني Competency Framework ممتاز… وبالنهاية محد يستخدمه! — Build it from the start with three people: the job holder, the line manager and HR. (https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7513834717582872576/)
- 2026-10-04 — إذا بدأت الـCompetency Framework من قائمة Competencies جاهزة، غالبًا بتطلع بإطار مرتب… — Start from the job: role outcome → critical task → competency → observable behaviour. (https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7512401731872505857/)
- 2026-09-30 — “الفريق يحتاج تدريب”… طيب خلنا نتأكد أول: هل فعلًا المشكلة تدريب؟ — Before finding a course: do they know the task? Is the procedure clear? Do they have the tools and authority? Or is it follow-up? (https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7510949775505063936/)
- 2026-09-28 — “أنا أسوي شغل أعلى من مسماي” — Before promoting, hand over part of the next level’s responsibilities — “I could” and “I did” are different things. (https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7510223724986650624/)
- 2026-09-21 — مفهوم الـ Career Progression… هل ترقيت أو لا؟ — Promotion changes your position; career progression builds your readiness for the next step. (https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7507678576004161536/)
- 2026-09-16 — 70:20:10… وأنا شخصيًا ما أوقف كثير عند النسب — Before booking a course: what experience can I give them? Who can they learn from? What do they really need to know? (https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7505874323396763648/)
- 2026-09-14 — في بداية قيادتي للفرق، كنت أعتقد أن وجودي في كل التفاصيل بيساعد الفريق على التعلّم. — A leader’s job isn’t to be in every detail — it’s knowing when to step in and when to leave room to learn. (https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7505138617090990080/)
- 2026-07-28 — بعد رفض ترقيتك، فيه 4 تصرفات تسوّيها بحسن نية، وكل وحدة تبعّدك عن ترقيتك الجاية. — The rejection doesn’t stop your path; what you do in the days after it decides. (https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7487754969828282368/)
- 2026-07-15 — هل نجهّز إدارات التدريب للمستقبل، ولا نجهّزها عشان تُستبدل فيه؟ — From a session with local and global experts: how AI changes needs analysis, content, assessment and succession — and where people still matter. (https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7483149127397330944/)
- 2026-07-06 — الحادث ما يبدأ لحظة وقوعه… يبدأ يوم نقتنع أن التدريب لحاله يكفي. — Reading a train derailment through technical readiness: the gap between training and competence. (https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7479789244396433408/)
- 2026-03-03 — العمل الذي لا يُرى، هو غالبًا العمل الأكثر تأثيرًا. — On the Riyadh Metro Heroes honour: a year of technical readiness behind the scenes, and a team that knew excellence isn’t built on slogans. (https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7434700669820968960/)

## FAQ

**What do you work on now?** I lead Learning & Capability Development at CAMCO on the Riyadh Metro Project: technical training, competency management, knowledge transfer, talent development, Saudization and workforce readiness.
**ما الذي تعمل عليه حاليًا؟** أقود التعلّم وتطوير القدرات في شركة مترو العاصمة «كامكو» ضمن مشروع مترو الرياض: التدريب الفني، وإدارة الكفاءة، ونقل المعرفة، وتطوير المواهب، والتوطين، وجاهزية القوى العاملة.

**What are the highlights?** Training for 3,220+ employees through 8,000+ learning interventions for Riyadh Metro’s operational readiness, TMS and CMS formally validated by the Transport General Authority, and recognition among the Riyadh Metro Heroes.
**ما أبرز ما تحقّق؟** تدريب أكثر من 3,220 موظفًا عبر أكثر من 8,000 تدخّل تعليمي لدعم الجاهزية التشغيلية لمترو الرياض، واعتماد نظامَي إدارة التدريب والكفاءة رسميًا من الهيئة العامة للنقل، والتكريم ضمن «أبطال مترو الرياض».

**Which professional credentials do you hold?** CPTD (ATD), PMP (PMI), the CIPD Level 5 Associate Diploma in People Management, SPTD (Human Capital Institute), TVTC Certified Trainer and CLDM, plus Competency Assessor and Verifier training.
**ما الشهادات المهنية التي تحملها؟** CPTD من ATD، وPMP من PMI، ودبلوم CIPD المستوى الخامس في إدارة الأفراد، وSPTD من Human Capital Institute، ومدرّب معتمد من المؤسسة العامة للتدريب التقني والمهني، وCLDM، إضافة إلى اعتمادَي مقيّم ومدقّق الكفاءة.

**Which sectors have you worked in?** Safety-critical sectors in Saudi Arabia and Bahrain: railways (Riyadh Metro), oil & gas, and construction.
**ما القطاعات التي عملت فيها؟** قطاعات حساسة للسلامة في السعودية والبحرين: السكك الحديدية (مترو الرياض)، والنفط والغاز، والإنشاءات.

**Which languages do you work in?** Arabic and English.
**بأي لغة يمكن التواصل؟** العربية والإنجليزية.
